title: Upgrade Kiichain Testnet Oro to v7.3.1
summary:
Upgrade Kiichain Testnet Oro to v7.3.1.
- Keeps the gov module account on the bank blocked list so EVM BalanceHandler does not mirror gov deposits into StateDB (fixes Safe → gov precompile deposit failing on commit with unauthorized).
- Release: https://github.com/KiiChain/kiichain/releases/tag/v7.3.1
- PR: https://github.com/KiiChain/kiichain/pull/368
- Changelog: https://github.com/KiiChain/kiichain/blob/v7.3.1/CHANGELOG.md
- Target time ~2026-08-08T13:53:00Z (~48h lead = 12h voting + ~36h validator staging; measured block time ~2.66s).
